g.text: Transfer-function factors locate finite zeros and poles in the complex s-plane

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Reduced rational LTI transfer function with zero initial conditions; gain factor K=2. Poles are denominator roots and zeros numerator roots. Hidden
unstable pole-zero cancellations can invalidate an input-output stability inference about the internal state; this example has no cancellation.
